text:
maria_p: Quick sync — Acme wants a private offer with a 24‑month committed spend but wants a mid-term SKU swap clause. Can we ship on this before EOD Friday?
liam_sales: they signed LOI, PMF signal is strong. We should protect renewal motion — propose a 10% downside protection if they downshift in year 2.
alex_pm: +1 to protecting renewal. Need to map which SKUs are swappable. Suggest opt-in migration window (30 days) and a replacement SKU list.
oliver_legal: we can do a guarded swap clause but need clear definitions: what counts as "equivalent SKU", any prorating calc, and a hard cap on swaps per contract period. I'll draft language.
sophie_eng: technical caveat — some on-prem appliance SKUs are end-of-life in Q4; migration might require data-plane migration work. We should include a handoff SLA from SI partners.
maria_p: good call. Also need marketplace listing implications for private offers (AWS/GC/AZ). If they accept PO via marketplace private offer, we can't change SKU mapping post-acceptance without new PO.
liam_sales: can we split the private offer into two SKUs: reserved capacity + integration retainer? That way they can swap reserved capacity SKU but keep retainer consistent.
alex_pm: that's clean. For billing: reserved SKU has usage floor; retainer is monthly. For migration math, propose this formula for refund/charge: 
```
pro_rata = remaining_months / total_months
net_delta = new_sku_price * pro_rata - old_sku_price * pro_rata
if net_delta > 0 => customer pays diff; else => credit applied to next invoice (no cash refunds)
```
maria_p: coderules look reasonable. oliver_legal can we avoid cash refunds? sounds better for ops.
oliver_legal: yes, we should avoid cash flow refunds where possible. Offer credits that can be used against future renewals. Need to cap credit accumulation and require 90‑day notice for large swaps (>25% of committed spend).
sophie_eng: SI onboarding note: require an integration checklist from partner before swap window opens — api keys, network ACLs, migration runbook. If partner fails checklist, swap is delayed and credits not triggered.
liam_sales: how do we reflect this in marketplace private offer UI? announce-bot: Deploy checklist created: /deploys/private-offer-acme-1748500000. (link)
maria_p: timeline — oliver_legal will send draft clause by Tue EOD, alex_pm to produce SKU mapping + swap formula by Wed, sophie to gate SI checklist by Thu, liam to confirm customer acceptance by Fri. If all green, we push PO to marketplace next week.
alex_pm: tagging ops: @sre and @billing for FYI on credit accounting.
oliver_legal: draft coming. Also adding renewal language: auto‑renew opt-out window 60 days pre-termination, and discounted renewal tiers tied to previous committed consumption (tiered discounts: 5/10/15).
maria_p: perfect. last question: do we allow hardware partner co-sell credits to stack with private-offer discounts?
liam_sales: we should allow stacking but with gross floor to protect margin. propose stacking up to an additional 5% but require partner co-fund approval.
oliver_legal: add a clause that partner credits are conditional on partner providing invoiceable proof.
sophie_eng: operational note: if stacking affects device provisioning (e.g., appliance SKU delta), SI will need 14 days lead time.
maria_p: great — everyone ok with next steps? :thumbsup:
liam_sales: :thumbsup:
alex_pm: :thumbsup:
oliver_legal: :thumbsup:
sophie_eng: :thumbsup:
